description: This file defines a PHP class 'Kint_Parsers_Color' which extends a base parser class. It handles parsing, converting, and rendering color values in CSS formats including named colors, hex, rgb, and hsl. The class includes methods for identifying suitable color strings, converting between color formats, and generating HTML previews. It also contains a static array of CSS3 named colors.

classes.name: Kint_Parsers_Color
classes.description: A parser class for handling and rendering CSS color values in different formats.

methods.name: _parse
methods.description: Parses the color variable to generate an HTML preview and color details, if the variable matches color formats.

methods.name: _fits
methods.description: Checks if the input string is a valid color representation (named, hex, rgb, hsl).

methods.name: _convert
methods.description: Converts a color input into different formats: hex, rgb, hsl, and name if applicable.

methods.name: _HSLtoRGB
methods.description: Converts HSL color values to RGB.

methods.name: _hue2rgb
methods.description: Helper function for HSL to RGB conversion, calculates RGB component based on hue.

methods.name: _RGBtoHSL
methods.description: Converts RGB color values to HSL.
